name: BSA Bantam
engine: 123 to 172 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, premix, flywheel magneto
intro: BSA's little two-stroke, based on the DKW RT125. Premix, a flywheel magneto and a huge production run.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
